cs.t: Right now I’m thinking of my Razer PC laptop.  Computer technology is always getting so much faster that yesterday’s expensive cutting-edge future-proof elite hardware is tomorrow’s slowpoke bottom-shelf e-waste.  Now, I will say it overall has been a good computer.  But I could have saved a lot of money getting something 10-20% slower and replacing it sooner.
cs.th: Ask HN: What are your most regretted tech purchases?
